{{Quote|Monster! That was my son! You didn't need to kill him!''"<br />"''We didn't need him at all. We are the victors. We do as we like with you.|Lonai's father and Tul'kar|<ref name="DOTJ 1" />}}
'''Tul'kar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] who served the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] of his [[Species/Legends|species]] as a [[Predor]], a military commander. Tul'kar trained the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] known as [[Tau (individual)|Xesh]] as his [[Force Hound]], and the young warrior led his master to many [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-rich [[Planet/Legends|planets]] across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] while in Tul'kar's service. In [[25,793 BBY]], Skal'nas employed Xesh's service in locating a particularly [[Tython/Legends|Force-strong world]] in the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]], and Tul'kar claimed right of conquest for the planet as Xesh was his Hound. However, Tul'kar's warship [[Devourer (Rakatan ship)|''Devourer'']] was severely damaged upon arrival in the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]], and Tul'kar was slain in the chaos by his own Hound, who stole Tul'kar's personal [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] and escaped the crash.

==Biography==
{{Quote|You have done well, Xesh&mdash;finding this planet, culling the sensitives. Yes, I think you are the best of the Force Hounds. and you are mine.|Tul'kar|<ref name="DOTJ 1" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]], Tul'kar rose to the rank of [[Predor]] within the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] well before the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[25,793 BBY]]. While surveying the [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] whom the Rakata used to power their machines, Tul'kar sensed great power in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] within a young [[Human/Legends|Human]] boy designated [[Tau (individual)|Xesh]], and he freed the boy from the machines in order to train him as a [[Force Hound]]&mdash;Force-sensitive warriors whom the Infinite Empire used to locate Force-rich [[Planet/Legends|planets]] across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="DOTJ 6" /> Under Tul'kar's tutelage, Xesh became a powerful Force Hound, and during his training, Tul'kar pitted Xesh against one of his broodmates, a girl named [[Trill (Force Hound)|Trill]], for his amusement. Xesh emerged victorious in their fight as Tul'kar watched, and Tul'kar handed Xesh a [[Forcesaber]]&mdash;a Rakatan weapon&mdash;to kill the fallen Trill. However, Xesh instead proposed that Trill be given as a Force Hound to [[Skal'nas]], Tul'kar's superior, and Tul'kar accepted the proposal in amusement.<ref name="DOTJ 7">[[Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan 2|''Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan'' 2]]</ref>

Sometime after this, a battle in the [[Arena of Byss|arena]] on the planet [[Byss/Legends|Byss]] was arranged between Xesh and Skal'nas's Force Hound [[Isk (Force Hound)|Isk]], and Tul'kar and Skal'nas made wagers on the outcome of the fight. Xesh ultimately emerged victorious, and Tul'kar gloated over Xesh's victory and lack of mercy as Skal'nas ordered Isk to be prepared for their table.<ref name="DOTJ 4" /> As Tul'kar's Force Hound, Xesh led his master to Force-rich worlds such as [[Sriluur/Legends|Sriluur]], home of the [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Species/Legends|species]],<ref name="DOTJ 6" /> and determined the strongest of the Force-sensitives among the planets' populations. In 25,793 BBY, Xesh led Tul'kar and his forces to the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], which Tul'kar's forces [[Conquest of Tatooine|conquered]] and captured many of the native [[Kumumgah/Legends|Kumumgah]].<ref name="DOTJ 1" />

[[File:TulkarXeshOremun-ForceStorm1.png|thumb|left|200px|Xesh and Tul'kar on Tatooine]]
At Tul'kar's command, Xesh culled the Force-sensitives from the population, and when the [[Lonai's father|father]] of a Kumumgah named [[Lonai]] grew enraged at his son's murder, Tul'kar [[Death/Legends|killed]] him with [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]]. When a Rakata named [[Ore'mun]] delivered a message from Skal'nas, requesting that Tul'kar and Xesh return to Skal'nas's [[Rakatan stronghold|stronghold]] on the planet [[Byss/Legends|Byss]] while Ore'mun remained behind to oversee the culling. Sensing Ore'mun's lust for his command, Tul'kar reached out with the Force and [[Telekinesis/Legends|gripped]] Ore'mun by the throat, choking him and then electrocuting to death. Tul'kar then ordered his subordinates to prepare Ore'mun's body so that he could consume his fallen rival.<ref name="DOTJ 1" />

On Byss, Skal'nas ignored Tul'kar's anger at being removed from the Tatooine conquest and explained that he required Xesh's skills&mdash;Trill had sensed a Force-rich world withing the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]], but she was unable to locate it precisely. When questioned by Skal'nas, Xesh admitted that he could find the world, but his words angered Trill and Tul'kar watched as the two Force Hounds began to battle each other&mdash;a battle that saw Xesh victorious and about to kill Trill before Skal'nas intervened. Irritated, Tul'kar expressed his desire to see who the dominant Force Hound would be, and the Predor was quick to declare right of conquest when Xesh answered Skal'nas's request for him to find the planet.<ref name="DOTJ 1" />

However, when Tul'kar's warship [[Devourer (Rakatan ship)|''Devourer'']] arrived in the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]], which contained [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]&mdash;the Force-rich world they sought&mdash;the ''Devourer'' became wracked with explosions. As the crippled warship fell toward Tython, Tul'kar and two of his guards fought their way through the panicking slaves aboard the ship to reach Tul'kar's [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]], but the Predor found his warriors who were tasked with guarding the pod had been slain when he arrived. Furious, Tul'kar demanded to know who was responsible, only for Xesh<ref name="DOTJ 4" />&mdash;under the mental control of Skal'nas<ref name="DOTJ 10">[[Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan 5|''Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan'' 5]]</ref>&mdash;to stab the Predor through the chest with his Forcesaber. Leaving his dead master aboard the ship, Xesh took the escape pod while the ''Devourer'' crashed on Tython's surface.<ref name="DOTJ 4" /> An enraged Skal'nas, when he found that the ''Devourer''{{'s}} reporting beacon was offline, believed that Tul'kar was trying to keep the world to himself and sent Trill to track down Xesh and the planet.<ref name="DOTJ 6" />

==Personality and traits==
[[File:TulkarForceLightning-ForceStorm1.jpg|thumb|right|160px|Tul'kar uses Force lightning.]]
{{Quote|You suggest both respect and insolence toward my superior in one bold gesture, ''slave''? You learn will.|Tul'kar|<ref name="DOTJ 7" />}}
A cruel and ruthless individual, Tul'kar was a male Rakata with blue skin and yellow [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. Tul'kar also had four diamond shape tattoos on the top of his head. Tul'kar spared no sympathy or emotion for those he considered to be lesser beings, and his sense of superiority led him to view his superior, Predor Skal'nas, with contempt. A cannibal like the rest of his species, Tul'kar was more than willing to eat his executed rivals, even if they were his subordinates or allies.<ref name="DOTJ 1" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|To take Xesh, Predor Skal'nas would have to meet me in battle, Ore'mun&mdash;and Predor Skal'nas knows that.|Tul'kar|<ref name="DOTJ 1" />}}
A powerful Force-sensitive with strength in the dark side, Tul'kar was capable of using both telekinesis and Force lightning, and he considered himself a particularly skilled warrior.<ref name="DOTJ 1" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|So if he ate the Rakata messenger, why did he kill the young boy on Tatooine?''"<br />"''Because he could.|Poster Micro_Chip and Randy Stradley|<ref name="JCF">{{JCFCite|url=posts/32090637|board=Literature|thread=Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm #1 (of 5)|user=Micro_Chip and Randy Stradley|date=2012-02-23|time=2:47 PM|
archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20220528222640/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/dawn-of-the-jedi-force-storm-1-of-5.31982217/page-8#post-32090637}}</ref>}}
Tul'kar was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi 0|preview issue 0]] for the ''[[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series,<ref name="DOTJ 0">[[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi 0|''Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi'' 0]]</ref> and he first appeared in the [[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 1|first issue]] of the series.<ref name="DOTJ 1" /> Tul'kar died during the events of the [[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 2|second issue]], though it was not depicted until the [[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 4|fourth]],<ref name="DOTJ 4" /> and he has appeared in flashbacks to Xesh and Trill's past in several later issues.<ref name="DOTJ 6" /><ref name="DOTJ 7" />
